risks.title: Cybersecurity and cyberattacks
risks.score_rationale: Risk is explicitly overseen by the Governance Committee and presented as a major priority with dedicated committees, regular assessments, and a CIO involved at executive level. Language indicates heightened vigilance against threats potentially critical to essential infrastructure. Cybersecurity category is highly weighted for utilities.

risks.title: Dependence on fossil fuels
risks.score_rationale: Present across multiple generation facilities (coal, natural gas) mentioned in capacity tables. Dependence on natural gas and coal exposes the company to fuel price volatility and regulatory pressure on emissions. Although not explicitly named as a risk, exposure is implicit through generation portfolio structure.

risks.title: Regulatory rate-setting and tariff approvals
risks.score_rationale: Rates are subject to OCC, APSC, and FERC oversight, mentioned in 'Overview'. Rate review process (e.g., 2025 decision) shows critical dependence on regulatory determinations. Language emphasizes importance of approvals for cost recovery, directly impacting profitability.

risks.title: Climate and weather risks
risks.score_rationale: MD&A explicitly mentions impact of milder weather conditions on revenues and high seasonality tied to air conditioning demand. This demonstrates direct sensitivity to climate variations, a recurring risk for utilities.

risks.title: Capital investments and cost management
risks.score_rationale: $3.1 billion in investments over three years, with depreciation and interest costs mentioned as negative factors. Reliance on borrowing (senior notes 2024/2025) and asset service additions increase cost pressure. Risk is central in MD&A.

risks.title: Federal renewable energy regulation
risks.score_rationale: Mention of federal 'One Big Beautiful Bill' modifying tax credits for renewables indicates strategic risk. Text notes these changes could influence future investment decisions, with potential impact on energy planning.

risks.title: Legal risks and litigation
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in 'Item 3. Legal Proceedings' as possible but not probable losses. Language indicates monitoring, but no material loss is anticipated. Litigation category is weighted moderately, and risk is assessed as minor at present.

ai_positioning.summary: OGE does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K report.
